
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/19965552" title="发布于 2026-05-02 08:58">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">7. 搞懂LangChain开发库，还有dotenv实战</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>为帮助开发者快速吃透 LangChain 整体架构、解决入门难题，本文将拆解项目核心模块，并讲解在实际项目中，API Key的常用配置和dotenv代码实战，内容简洁易懂，兼顾理论认知与实际开发落地。</p>
<p>如果喜欢看视频学习的，可以看这个<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1gSo5BvEmU/" rel="noopener nofollow">《7. 搞懂LangChain开发库，还有dotenv实战》</a>，喜欢看文章的接着往下看。</p>
<p>1. LangChain项目工程<br>LangChain 项目采用职责清晰的模块化架构，核心模块定位与能力边界如下：</p>
<p>langchain-core：LangChain 全生态的核心基石，统一定义了生态内所有通用抽象接口、交互协议与核心数据结构，是所有上层组件与集成能力的底层依赖。</p>
<p>langchain-classic：历史版本兼容包，仅用于存量旧项目的平滑兼容与运维支撑，不推荐新项目引入使用。</p>
<p>langchain_v1：当前官方主推的生产级主用版本，核心聚焦大模型智能体（Agent）的全链路构建，封装了开箱即用的核心开发能力。</p>
<p>partners 集成库：由 LangChain 官方维护的第三方生态集成集合；其中 Anthropic、DeepSeek、OpenAI 等主流大模型的核心集成，均由 LangChain 官方与对应厂商联合开发维护，保障接口兼容性与长期稳定性。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502084932598-1358253662.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;其中，OpenAI&nbsp;<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="API" data-pretit="api">API&nbsp;已成为大模型服务领域的行业事实标准，目前绝大多数主流大模型厂商，均提供了与该标准完全兼容的 API 接口，可实现跨模型的低成本无缝切换。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502084951049-1663618869.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>2. 申请API Key<br>接入任意大模型平台的服务前，均需先在对应平台申请专属的 API 密钥（API Key），用于接口调用时的身份鉴权与调用额度管控。</p>
<p>针对个人开发者的开发测试场景，优先推荐阿里云百炼、火山引擎两大平台，二者均为个人开发者提供了充足的免费调用额度，可充分满足日常功能调试、原型验证的全流程需求。</p>
<p>进到阿里云百炼后台https://bailian.console.aliyun.com，点击【API Key】，进到创建API密钥的窗口。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085009328-1523688534.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;找到右上角【创建API Key】按钮并点击，这时会弹出一个窗口。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085023457-1317674178.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;直接点击【确定】按钮即可。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085035567-100573683.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;API Key创建好了，点击【复制】按钮并保存到本地文件(自己随意创建一个txt文件)。接着点击【关闭】按钮，之后点击【阿里云百炼logo】，回到主窗口。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085047481-386747769.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;在主窗口中，找到【免费额度】并进行点击。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085059476-153322088.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;为了避免大模型用量超额，你需要进行设置。找到右边【批量操作免费额度用完即停】按钮并进行点击。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085115007-538813702.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;在下拉菜单，点击【批量开启】选项。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085130885-637675099.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;操作不能停，还要按下【一键开启所有模型】按钮。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085152142-1529599940.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;一开始时，我就开启过，现在是开启最近新增的模型，点击【开启免费额度用完即停】按钮。过一会就会全部开启完了。然后要使用的大模型名称并复制保存起来，建议选择最近的(比如qwen3.6-plus)，旧版的到一定时间会下架的。接着点击顶部【文档】链接。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085207187-920309361.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;找到代码中base_url，复制https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1并保存起来。注意，这里的示例代码是LangChain旧版本的。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085227565-1986512845.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h4>3. 创建工程并进行dotenv实战</h4>
<p>用<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="PyCharm" data-pretit="pycharm">PyCharm创建一个项目工程之后，创建main.py文件，内容如下，这种直接把API_Key写在代码里的做法叫硬编码，它最大的问题是不灵活：换大模型要改代码，还容易泄露密钥。&nbsp;</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>OPENAI_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">”你的API Key”
OPENAI_BASE_URL</span>=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v1
MODEL</span>=qwen3.6-plus</pre>
</div>
<p>为保障调用凭证安全，可将API_KEY和BASE_UR配置至系统环境变量里。用户变量只对当前登录计算机的用户有效，系统变量对所有用户都有效。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085323734-578350156.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;配置之后，可以重启计算机生效，也可以通过如下方式生效。打开命令行窗口并运行如下命令进行刷新。接着需要退出命令行窗口，同时需要重启PyCharm。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>set PATH=%PATH%</pre>
</div>
<p>打开main.py文件，输入如下代码。os.getenv()函数，通过指定key获取环境变量的值，如果获取不到，会返回None。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dotenv
api_key</span>=os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
base_url</span>=os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(api_key)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(base_url)</pre>
</div>
<p>在开发产品时，常将用户自己配置的API密钥和URL放在.env文件里。新建.env文件，API密钥的值，加点不一样的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>OPENAI_API_KEY=“你的API密码-666<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">”
OPENAI_BASE_URL</span>=“https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v1”
MODEL</span>=“qwen3.6-plus”</pre>
</div>
<p>读写.env文件，需要用pip安装dotenv开发包。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install dotenv</pre>
</div>
<p>用import语法引进dotenv；load_dotenv()，默认加载当前目录下的.env文件。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
 
load_dotenv()
api_key </span>= os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
base_url </span>= os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(api_key)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(base_url)</pre>
</div>
<p>运行代码之后，你会发现，返回的还是系统环境变量里配置的值，这是因为同名下，系统环境变量优先级高。删掉系统环境变量里的OPENAI_API_KEY和OPENAI_BASE_URL。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085323734-578350156.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;打开命令行窗口并运行如下命令进行刷新。接着需要退出命令行窗口，同时需要重启PyCharm。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>set PATH=%PATH%</pre>
</div>
<p>打开main.py文件并运行之后，就会输出.env里的OPENAI_API_KEY和OPENAI_BASE_URL的值了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>你的API密码-666<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
https:</span>//dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1</pre>
</div>
<p>4. dotenv应用实战</p>
<p>用PyCharm新建一个新的项目工程，用pip安装dotenv和pyside6。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install dotenv pyside6</pre>
</div>
<p>在项目中，新建.env文件，如下是国内AI大模型厂家的API调用地址，在使用的时候，自己核对一下。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 阿里巴巴-通义千问 ==========</span>
QWEN_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
QWEN_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
QWEN_CONSOLE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://dashscope.console.aliyun.com/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
QWEN_MODELS</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">qwen3.6-plus,qwen-3.5-plus,qwen-3.5-72b-instruct</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 月之暗面 - Kimi ==========</span>
KIMI_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
KIMI_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://api.moonshot.cn/v1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
KIMI_CONSOLE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://platform.moonshot.cn/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
KIMI_MODELS</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">moonshot-v1-8k,moonshot-v1-128k,moonshot-v1-256k</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== MiniMax ==========</span>
MINIMAX_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
MINIMAX_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://api.minimax.chat/v1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
MINIMAX_CONSOLE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://platform.minimax.chat/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
MINIMAX_MODELS</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">abab-6.5-chat,abab-6.5-pro,minimax-m2.7,minimax-m2-her</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 智谱AI-智谱清言 ==========</span>
ZHIPU_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ZHIPU_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ZHIPU_CONSOLE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://open.bigmodel.cn/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ZHIPU_MODELS</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">glm-4.5-flash,glm-4.5-pro,glm-4-air</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 字节跳动-豆包 ==========</span>
DOUBAO_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
DOUBAO_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
DOUBAO_CONSOLE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://console.volcengine.com/ark/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重要：豆包不直接使用模型名称，必须替换为火山方舟创建的推理接入点ID</span>
DOUBAO_MODELS=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">doubao-pro-32k,doubao-lite-32k,doubao-pro-128k</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 百度-文心一言 ==========</span>
ERNIE_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ERNIE_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://qianfan.baidubce.com/v2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ERNIE_CONSOLE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://console.bce.baidu.com/qianfan/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ERNIE_MODELS</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ernie-4.0-turbo-8k,ernie-3.5-turbo-128k,ernie-speed-128k</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 腾讯-混元 ==========</span>
HUNYUAN_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
HUNYUAN_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://api.hunyuan.cloud.tencent.com/v1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
HUNYUAN_CONSOLE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://console.cloud.tencent.com/hunyuan/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
HUNYUAN_MODELS</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hunyuan-turbo,hunyuan-pro,hunyuan-lite</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== DeepSeek ==========</span>
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://api.deepseek.com/v1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
DEEPSEEK_CONSOLE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://platform.deepseek.com/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
DEEPSEEK_MODELS</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">deepseek-chat,deepseek-reasoner</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></pre>
</div>
<p>新建一个env_util.py文件，用来封装dotenv对.env文件的操作。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv, set_key

            QPushButton {
                background-color: #1890ff;
                color: white;
                border: none;

                font-size: 14px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #40a9ff;
            }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        self.save_btn.clicked.connect(self.save_config)
 
        config_layout.addLayout(base_url_group)
        config_layout.addLayout(api_key_group)
        config_layout.addWidget(model_section)
        config_layout.addWidget(self.save_btn)
 
        content_layout.addWidget(title)
        content_layout.addLayout(provider_group)
        content_layout.addWidget(self.config_area)
        content_layout.addStretch()
 
        scroll </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidget(content)
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.NoFrame)
 
        layout.addWidget(scroll)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_env(self):
        providers </span>= [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">QWEN</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DOUBAO</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">KIMI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MINIMAX</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ZHIPU</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ERNIE</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HUNYUAN</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DEEPSEEK</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        self.config </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.env_util.load_config(providers)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> save_env(self):
        self.env_util.save_config(self.config)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> open_api_key_url(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.current_provider:
            config </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.config.get(self.current_provider, {})
            url </span>= config.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">console_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> url:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> webbrowser
                webbrowser.open(url)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handle_provider_change(self, index):
        provider </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.providers_list[index]
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> provider:
            self.config_area.setVisible(False)
            self.current_provider </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
        self.current_provider </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> provider
        self.load_config_to_form(provider)
        self.config_area.setVisible(True)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_config_to_form(self, provider):
        config </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.config.get(provider, {})
 
        self.api_key_input.setText(config.get(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">api_key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
        self.base_url_input.setText(config.get(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">base_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
 
        self.render_model_list(config.get(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">models</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, []))
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> render_model_list(self, models):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> reversed(range(self.model_list_layout.count())):
            item </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.model_list_layout.takeAt(i)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> item.widget():
                item.widget().deleteLater()
 
        self.model_items </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> model_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> models:
            model_item </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ModelItem(model_name)
            model_item.delete_btn.clicked.connect(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> checked, mi=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model_item: self.remove_model(mi))
            self.model_list_layout.addWidget(model_item)
            self.model_items.append(model_item)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> add_model(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.current_provider:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
        model_item </span>= ModelItem(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        model_item.delete_btn.clicked.connect(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> checked, mi=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model_item: self.remove_model(mi))
        self.model_list_layout.addWidget(model_item)
        self.model_items.append(model_item)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> remove_model(self, model_item):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.current_provider:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
        index </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.model_items.index(model_item)
        model_item.deleteLater()
        self.model_items.pop(index)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> save_config(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.current_provider:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
        models </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.model_items:
            models.append(item.input.text())
 
        self.config[self.current_provider] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">api_key</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: self.api_key_input.text(),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">base_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: self.base_url_input.text(),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">models</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: models
        }
 
        self.save_env()
 
        QMessageBox.information(self, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">配置已保存！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
